reviews.text: The staff are very friendly, professional, and always ready to help.

The staff is friendly but too small to get advice late in the evening, for example. Also, the store often closes slightly before the stated time, by about 5 minutes, but it happened to us several times.

I especially want to thank Clémentine for her warm welcome! She was absolutely lovely, always smiling, attentive, and above all, offered excellent advice. You can really tell she loves her job and takes the time to properly advise her customers. It's so nice to encounter such a kind and caring salesperson. 🥰 …

My first attempt at buying online was unsuccessful; the product I chose, which was listed as in stock, turned out to be out of stock, and Animalis canceled and refunded my order very quickly. I found another model, and this time my order wasn't canceled. I received all the information regarding the tracking of my product and picked it up in store on time. The service at the store was quick, friendly, and efficient. So, perfect!
There is a wide selection for pets and the staff are welcoming and friendly.

I'm a customer of the Animalis store on Rue Damrémont in the 18th arrondissement of Paris. The store is very welcoming, and the staff are very attentive and helpful. I find all the products I need for my cat, Prune. For the cat litter, which is heavy (15 kilos), I have it delivered.
Everything is perfect for me.
Very kind and efficient staff, thank you for your advice.

🥰Beautiful store.
Very kind and helpful staffing .
We found a nice little bed for my little green friend. …
The staff are very friendly and efficient!
Top-notch store!

Fantastic welcome! A huge thank you to Clémentine, the manager, for her excellent advice, professionalism, and genuine commitment to customer service. Thank you for your kindness and for the warm welcome you gave us in your store. I highly recommend it!

Excellent welcome! A big thank you to Clémentine, the store manager, for her great advice, professionalism, and outstanding customer service. Thank you for your kindness and for making us feel so welcome in your store. I would happily recommend it! 😉
Excellent customer service!
Super boutique with a super friendly, smiling and helpful staff!
Super friendly welcome and a great selection. Top-notch!

As a customer visiting with my young dog, I was very disappointed by the sales tactics used in the store. I came in looking for a nutritional transition solution, but the saleswoman tried every possible way to sell me their store brand ("Nath"), completely unfoundedly disparaging recognized veterinary clinical nutrition brands (Virbac, Royal Canin, etc.), even going so far as to compare them to "fast food."

Wanting to make sales and meet targets for store brands is one thing, but making the customer feel guilty with scientifically unsound marketing arguments is quite another. A little more ethics and genuine consideration for the animal's needs would be much appreciated.
Friendly and competent staff, but products are often out of stock. Restocking seems difficult.
Pomme is always very well received in HER store. The range of choices is wide, but the biggest plus is definitely the team, always friendly and offering excellent advice.
Exactly what I expected: a wide selection of food, leisure items, and toiletries. Good value for money. Excellent service and advice!
Super friendly staff, professional and good advice.

Please feel free to come back and see us to discover our new products or for any other inquiries. We would be delighted to welcome you again!

Sincerely,

The Animalis Paris 18 - Jules Joffrin Team

Hello.

I received excellent service; the salesperson was perfect: kind, available, pleasant, and helpful. This is my second time visiting this shop, and I'm very happy with it.
Super service client!
Friendly welcome, excellent value for money, and a wide selection. Stock levels aren't always up-to-date (a victim of its own success!), but it's still a very good place to shop.

It's unacceptable that no one answers the phone; it's the closest store to my home in the 18th arrondissement. The others, however, answer. What's the problem with this store? I'm going to report this to head office.

Hello,
I regularly shop at this store because it's the closest one. The times I've come and asked for advice on cat toys, I haven't been satisfied because one of the salespeople made it quite clear, rather coldly, that he didn't know anything about them… so he wasn't receptive at all. Despite this, I kept coming back because it's more convenient. This time, I met a lovely person named Sarah, very kind, smiling, and of course, caring. She kindly recommended a toy that my cats absolutely loved. So, a big thank you again for her patience and professionalism.

Unfriendly staff. Not a hello, not a goodbye. Nothing. Even if you pass the staff upon entering the store. I even have to mention that I have a loyalty card because otherwise I'm rushed to the checkout and the exit.
